arguments.sql:
WITH metric_rows AS (
    SELECT m._year, m._month, m.month_year, m.interest_id, m.composition, m.index_value
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
),
map_counts AS (
    SELECT i.id, COUNT(*) AS name_rows, COUNT(i.interest_name) AS nonnull_names
    FROM main.interest_map AS i
    GROUP BY i.id
),
by_interest AS (
    SELECT m._year, m._month, m.interest_id,
           COUNT(*) AS metric_rows,
           SUM(m.composition IS NULL OR m.index_value IS NULL OR m.index_value = 0) AS undefined_ratios,
           SUM(m.month_year IS NOT printf('%02d-%04d', m._month, m._year)) AS month_label_mismatches,
           AVG(m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS ratio,
           COALESCE(i.name_rows, 0) AS name_rows,
           COALESCE(i.nonnull_names, 0) AS nonnull_names
    FROM metric_rows AS m
    LEFT JOIN map_counts AS i ON i.id = m.interest_id
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
)
SELECT _year, _month, SUM(metric_rows) AS metric_rows,
       COUNT(*) AS interests, MAX(metric_rows) AS max_rows_per_interest,
       SUM(undefined_ratios) AS undefined_ratios, SUM(month_label_mismatches) AS month_label_mismatches,
       SUM(name_rows = 0) AS interests_without_mapping,
       SUM(name_rows > 1) AS interests_with_duplicate_mapping,
       SUM(name_rows > nonnull_names) AS interests_with_null_name,
       MAX(ratio) AS top_ratio,
       SUM(ratio = monthly_max) AS interests_at_top
FROM (
    SELECT *, MAX(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY _year, _month) AS monthly_max
    FROM by_interest
)
GROUP BY _year, _month
ORDER BY _year, _month

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
    SELECT printf('%04d-%02d-01', m._year, m._month) AS month_start,
           m.interest_id,
           AVG(m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS avg_index_composition
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
),
ranked_interests AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           interest_id,
           avg_index_composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY month_start
               ORDER BY avg_index_composition DESC, interest_id
           ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
    WHERE avg_index_composition IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_history AS (
    SELECT r.month_start,
           i.interest_name,
           r.avg_index_composition AS max_index_composition,
           AVG(r.avg_index_composition) OVER (
               month_order ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS three_month_rolling_avg,
           LAG(i.interest_name, 1) OVER month_order AS one_month_ago_interest_name,
           LAG(r.avg_index_composition, 1) OVER month_order AS one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
           LAG(i.interest_name, 2) OVER month_order AS two_months_ago_interest_name,
           LAG(r.avg_index_composition, 2) OVER month_order AS two_months_ago_max_index_composition
    FROM ranked_interests AS r
    JOIN main.interest_map AS i ON i.id = r.interest_id
    WHERE r.month_rank = 1
    WINDOW month_order AS (ORDER BY r.month_start)
)
SELECT month_start,
       interest_name,
       max_index_composition,
       three_month_rolling_avg,
       one_month_ago_interest_name,
       one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
       two_months_ago_interest_name,
       two_months_ago_max_index_composition
FROM monthly_history
WHERE month_start >= '2018-09-01'
ORDER BY month_start
